_meta.dash_probe: Every prefix is also fed to dash as dash <context>, <prefix>(<value>) name(zqdash), on the plot type twoway took the full name on; the entry for the measured minimum abbreviation is reported under "dash", with the landing key read back out of the registered spec.  abbrev_resolution's dash_maps_to is the key dash recorded for the spelling with the value of the option twoway binds it to, else the option dash's declarations bind it to.
_meta.method: For each option/plottype the shortest prefix P is sought such that twoway accepts P AND P resolves to the intended option.  The second half is enforced with a resolution oracle: each probe is saved to a live-format .gph (a plain-text graph-object script), the echoed command line and the per-run object ids are normalised away, and the text is compared with the .gph produced by the full option name.  Return code alone is NOT sufficient: twoway accepts xl(3000) and t(ZQSENTINEL), but they resolve to xlabel() and t1title().
_meta.oracle_caveat: Options whose .gph output is identical to the no-option baseline cannot use the identity oracle.  Those entries carry oracle="return-code-only ..." or a dedicated side-effect oracle (graph-created-under-name, file-written) and are flagged as such.
_meta.oracle_selfcheck: the same twoway command run twice, more than a second apart, normalises to identical text: PASS
